n=22
grid=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
def put(coords,color):
    for r,c in coords:
        if not (0<=r<n and 0<=c<n): raise ValueError((r,c))
        if grid[r][c] not in (0,color): print('COLLISION', (r,c), grid[r][c],color)
        grid[r][c]=color
# Original color 4 remains fixed
put([(r,c) for r in range(10,13) for c in range(8,11)],4)
# Color 6, shifted (+5,+5)
c6=[(2,c) for c in range(4,9)]+[(3,4),(3,8),(4,8),(5,8),(6,7),(6,8)]
put([(r+5,c+5) for r,c in c6],6)
# Color 5, shifted (-9,-1)
c5=[(16,c) for c in range(16,19)]+[(17,18)]+[(18,c) for c in range(16,19)]
put([(r-9,c-1) for r,c in c5],5)
# Color 3, shifted (-4,+3)
c3=[(16,9),(16,10),(17,10),(18,10)]+[(19,c) for c in range(6,11)]
put([(r-4,c+3) for r,c in c3],3)
# Color 1 shifted (+3,+13)
c1=[(9,2),(9,3),(10,3),(11,3),(12,2),(12,3)]
put([(r+3,c+13) for r,c in c1],1)
# Markers from all components after rigid translations
markers=[]
markers += [(2+5,9+5),(4+5,4+5),(4+5,9+5),(6+5,6+5)]
markers += [(9,9),(11,11),(12,11),(13,9)]
markers += [(16-4,8+3),(16-4,11+3),(17-4,6+3),(19-4,11+3)]
markers += [(9+3,1+13),(12+3,1+13)]
markers += [(16-9,15-1),(18-9,15-1)]
for r,c in set(markers):
    if grid[r][c] not in (0,2): print('MARKER COLLISION WITH BODY', (r,c),grid[r][c])
    grid[r][c]=2
print('markers raw',markers,'unique',sorted(set(markers)))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in grid))
